This film is about a young probable hockey player, Ajit Singh, who gets trapped in a tragic situation during the dark days of Punjab.  The trailer of the movie was released on 13 April 2016. Tragic Hero (film) | Tragic Hero (Cantonese Yale: Ying hung ho hon) is a 1987 Hong Kong action-crime film directed by Taylor Wong, and starring Andy Lau, Chow Yun-fat and Alex Man.  The film is the sequel to "Rich and Famous" but was released first due to its appeal as an action film.
Vaapsi | Vaapsi (ਵਾਪਸੀ) is an upcoming drama film, Punjabi film directed by Rakesh Mehta and starring Harish Verma, Sameksha, Dhrriti Saharan and Gulshan Grover as the main protagonists of the film.  This film is about a young probable hockey player, Ajit Singh, who gets trapped in a tragic situation during the dark days of Punjab.  The trailer of the movie was released on 13 April 2016.  The release date of the film is 3 June 2016.
